content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete, self-owned digital commerce stack. It replaces platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle with tools you control. The core problem is not just payment processing—it’s the entire architecture. Stripe and PayPal exclude Nigeria not because of technical limitations, but because of financial and regulatory policies. They cannot operate in regions with volatile currencies, weak banking systems, or high fraud rates. COREMERCH bypasses this by using decentralized payment networks (via NOWPayments) and free, open hosting platforms (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages). You own the code, the data, and the delivery mechanism. This is not a temporary fix. It’s a permanent, scalable solution built for regions where conventional platforms fail.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours and uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. When a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. This webhook fires Cloudflare Workers to update Supabase and deliver the ebook via R2. The entire process is automatic, secure, and does not require a buyer account. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. You own the entire stack after deployment—COREMERCH has no access. This architecture is designed to withstand currency collapses, payment blockades, and platform shutdowns.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in Nigeria and similar markets who sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software but cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. These creators are not victims—they are architects choosing better infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack is for those who want lifetime ownership of their commerce tools, not temporary access. It’s for creators who understand that relying on platforms is a liability, not an asset. If you’ve been rejected by payment processors or had your account frozen, this is your structural alternative. It’s also for creators who want to scale globally without geographic restrictions. The stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm. It works where others fail.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s the new base layer.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront for free, with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, from payment verification to file delivery. Supabase stores order data securely, with real-time updates. Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly, with no bandwidth limits. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. The stack is configured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability and end-to-end tested before handover. Each component is free or low-cost, with no hidden fees. You pay once for deployment and own everything afterward. This is not a SaaS product—it’s a blueprint for infrastructure sovereignty.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your product catalog and payment preferences. Choose low-fee networks like BSC or Solana for transactions. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. COREMERCH deploys your stack in 48 hours, loads up to 5 products, and provides 30-day support. After deployment, you own the code, data, and delivery mechanism. Scale by adding more products or integrating additional tools. The stack is designed for growth, not just survival. This is how you build a commerce system that cannot be shut down, blocked, or taken away. It’s not a workaround—it’s the new base layer.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed and configured by COREMERCH. You receive a fully functional system with 30-day support. No coding required.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is decentralized, with no single point of failure. Even if their service is disrupted, your stack remains operational because you own the code and data.
Can I accept fiat currency with this stack?
No. The stack is designed for crypto payments only, using networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low fees and fast transactions.
How do I update my product catalog after deployment?
You can edit your Supabase database directly or use the included management interface. Full documentation is provided with the stack.
What if I need to scale beyond 5 products?
The stack is built for scalability. You can add more products by updating your Supabase database and Cloudflare R2 storage. No additional deployment required.
